intents.title: How I prove it works
intents.md:
Every flagship repo runs CI on each push. Right now **16 of 16 are green**.

- Tests ship with the code: 45 in llm-control-plane (93% coverage), 95 in EdgeInfer, 75 in PeerVault, 434 in Factory Monitor.
- Benchmarks are reproducible and labelled honestly. *Synthetic*, *mock* and *pending* results are marked as such, never passed off as production numbers.
- Full evidence matrix: [EVIDENCE.md](https://github.com/itsoumya-d/itsoumya-d/blob/main/EVIDENCE.md)

intents.title: How I work with AI agents
intents.md: Agent-first, but reviewable. I drive Claude Code and Codex with an AGENTS.md per repo, write the tests first, and keep human review checkpoints before anything merges. Evals measure the agent's output (schema validity, field accuracy, p50/p95 latency, cost per call) instead of trusting it. Four Anthropic Academy credentials cover the Claude API, Claude Code and MCP.
